mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1 percentage points, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 1% from prior month, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 115 signals manufacturing sector contraction that increases input costs and reduces corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when INDPRO < 115, or INDPRO Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of employment (PAYEMS) indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS exceeds 135,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index level above 208.0 indicates high inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL > 208.0, or CPIAUCSL Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment (UNRATE) and declines in employment (PAYEMS) indicate severe labor market contraction that reduces consumer confidence and corporate hiring, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In strong consumer demand (CPIAUCSL > 208.0), a decline in residential construction (HOUST) below 1400 thousand units signals housing market cooling that reduces overall demand and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL > 208.0 and HOUST < 1400, or HOUST Rank IC in this regime falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
